engine_texture: swatch 0 (Material.001 painted nodes) + rm_gbuffer vehicle_finish wear
source: RAL Classic CIELAB as tabulated in en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_RAL_colours (RAL CLASSIC register) (RAL 7021, period name Dunkelgrau Nr. 46, the Tiger factory finish to Feb 1943). Roughness 0.75 = the engine's flat paint (tank.rs tiger_paint_finish); IOR 1.5 = oil/alkyd binder
note: The engine swatch 0 is sRGB 72/74/78 (L*~31), lighter than the RAL chip (L* 20.6): the engine value reads as field-weathered grey; this is the chip.

engine_texture: swatch 0 alternative (spring 1943 scheme; not in the engine)
source: ESTIMATE. RAL 7028 is not in the current RAL Classic register and no instrumental measurement was found (Weald Foundation SEM match paywalled). Lab chosen as a mid tan between RAL 7008 (41/4/23) and RAL 1001 (74/6/27), per descriptions of "dark yellow ... tan with a greenish tinge"
note: Commonly cited as ordered 18 Feb 1943 (HM 1943 Nr. 181) as the new base colour; a factory change, so a spring-1943 vehicle may carry either.

source: RAL Classic CIELAB as tabulated in en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_RAL_colours (RAL CLASSIC register) (RAL 1001, period name Elfenbein). Roughness 0.70 = engine Interior Paint

source: RAL Classic CIELAB as tabulated in en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_RAL_colours (RAL CLASSIC register) (RAL 8012 Rotbraun, the usual citation for German factory primer). Iron-oxide primer is matte: roughness 0.82
